answer: Each new identity must lock a unique relic of capital and publish its funding path before any peer will countersign. Audits fire on a quartz interval: if two keys share a wallet, mixer hop, or key shard, both relics burn and the countersigners are slashed, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand full bonds. Honest agents post once and recover the lock after a delay. A public raven ledger of burned receipts lets peers reject any later alias from the same source.
